strategies.name: Baseline Loop-Unrolled Eight All-Reduces
strategies.desc: Directly implements 8 sequential all-reduce stages with interleaved local bidiagonal coupling and reverse operations as shown in reference. Each stage performs one all-reduce dispatch followed by local tensor manipulations (forward coupling + reduce-scatter semantics via division, then backward decoupling). Total 8 all-reduce dispatches with maximum fusion of local operations between collectives.

strategies.name: Reduce-Scatter then All-Gather per Stage
strategies.desc: Replaces each all-reduce with reduce-scatter followed by all-gather, exploiting the fact that bidiagonal coupling only needs local shard after summation. Each rank reduce-scatters its contribution, applies bidiagonal transform locally on its assigned shard, then all-gathers to reconstruct full vector for next stage. 16 total dispatches (8 reduce-scatter + 8 all-gather) but each moves 1/W of the payload, potentially better bandwidth utilization.

strategies.name: Fused Bidiagonal-Coupling Custom Collective
strategies.desc: Pre-computes the composition of 8 bidiagonal transforms algebraically into a single sparse linear operator, then performs one all-reduce of the input followed by local application of the composed transform matrix. Reduces to 1 all-reduce dispatch on full payload, trading collective count for increased local computation (sparse matrix-vector multiply with O(W) non-zeros per row).

strategies.name: Pipelined Ring-Based Bidiagonal Propagation
strategies.desc: Exploits nearest-neighbor structure in bidiagonal coupling by organizing 224 ranks into a ring topology. Each stage uses point-to-point send/recv to propagate shard boundaries (enabling incremental bidiagonal coupling) while simultaneously reducing local contributions via a ring all-reduce pattern. 8 stages × O(W) ring steps = O(8W) small message dispatches, optimizing for latency-hiding through pipelining.

strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Level Reduction with Inter-Node Aggregation
strategies.desc:
Leverages multi-node structure by performing intra-node all-reduce (across cores_per_device × num_devices per node), applying bidiagonal transforms at node level, then inter-node all-reduce for global aggregation. Each of 8 stages performs 2 all-reduces (local + global) on smaller groups, totaling 16 dispatches but with significantly reduced per-dispatch payload and better NUMA/interconnect topology alignment.
